response.answer: An RCT in Nigeria and Vietnam used fruit vouchers to boost fruit affordability and consumption among urban households, showing improved dietary intake and health outcomes. The study focused on operational plans, digital tracking, and data security, with policy relevance for nutrition programs. The results support integrating vouchers in urban food access strategies.

results.title: Barriers to consumption of fruits and vegetables and strategies to overcome them in low- and middle-income countries: a narrative review | Nutrition Research Reviews | Cambridge Core
results.content: # Barriers to consumption of fruits and vegetables and strategies to overcome them in low- and middle-income countries: a narrative review. This review provides an overview of the barriers to the consumption of fruits and vegetables (FVs) as well as strategies to improve the intake of FVs in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Trends in the consumption of FVs in LMICs are also summarised. This review has research implications due to the positive outcomes of strategies that lower such barriers and boost consumption of FVs in LMICs. # Save article to Kindle.
